ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, points D and E are located on sides $AB$ and $AC$ respectively, with $DE\parallel BC$. If $DE:BC = 2:3$, then what is the ratio of ${S}_{\triangle ADE}$ to ${S}_{\triangle ABC}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE\parallel BC$,\\
it follows that $\triangle ADE\sim \triangle ABC$,\\
therefore $\frac{{S}_{\triangle ADE}}{{S}_{\triangle ABC}}=\left(\frac{DE}{BC}\right)^{2}=\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{2}=\boxed{\frac{4}{9}}$.
